text:
MGN 600 (M) Amendment 3 Maritime Labour Convention - Inspection of coded vessels
Amendment 3 provides guidance on the arrangements in place for inspection for Maritime Labour Convention compliance.
Documents
Details
This notice, together with MGN 601(M) and MGN 602(M), replaces MGN 490 amendment 1 and MGN 491 amendment 1 published in August 2014 and replaces MGN 600(M) amendment 2.
Amendment 3 updates contact details for those applying for Maritime Labour Certificates and updates references.
Notice to
- small vessel owners
- operators and managers
- seafarers
- designers
- builders and surveyors
